title: 查詢步數紀錄
question:
你有一支智慧手環，會記錄一週每天走的步數。
請先輸入七天的步數（星期一到星期日）存進清單，再輸入一個整數 n（1 到 7），代表要查星期幾，輸出那一天的步數。
提示：星期 n 是清單的第幾個位置？想一想清單是從哪裡開始算的。

en.title: Step Record
en.question:
Your smart band records your steps every day for a week.
Input the steps for 7 days (Monday to Sunday) into a list. Then input a number n (1 to 7) for the day you want. Output the steps of that day.
Tip: Day n is at which place in the list? Think about where the list starts.
